purpose: Evidence-backed camera targets and deployment-preview settings for table, side, and wrist views. These compressed-video statistics constrain broad appearance only; they are not a photometric or geometric calibration.

deployment_stream.preview_approximation: area resize followed by an RGB-to-I420-to-RGB round trip; no claim of AV1 bitstream equivalence

evidence.training_authorization: unconfirmed; use for simulator fitting and held-out evaluation until organizers clarify
evidence.cube_size_note: Archive task metadata says 10 mm, but compressed pixels cannot resolve the project's 10 mm versus 16 mm physical-cube question.

table.fixed_training_gain_status: provisional gain from the current reference Isaac replay neutral median to the curated real-camera fit median; use without per-frame renormalization
table.profile_status: curated decoded compressed-video fit; whole-episode held-out check

side.fixed_training_gain_status: provisional gain from the current reference Isaac replay neutral median to the curated real-camera fit median; use without per-frame renormalization
side.profile_status: curated decoded compressed-video fit; whole-episode held-out check

wrist.fixed_training_gain_status: provisional gain from the current reference Isaac replay neutral median to the curated real-camera fit median; use without per-frame renormalization
wrist.profile_status: curated decoded compressed-video fit; wrist held-out shift tracks hose occlusion

synthetic_hose_occlusion.status: provisional layered, alpha-blended, defocused image-space robustness augmentation
synthetic_hose_occlusion.evidence: The curated stress episodes show a large blue component in 100% of 1 Hz samples with median largest-component area about 9-10%; held-out episode 10 exceeds 2% in about 60% of samples and reaches about 15.5%. The proxy can include blue hardware/cubes and is not a semantic mask.

limitations: The archived videos are 640x360 AV1/YUV420 and cannot recover native sensor noise, camera response, sharpness, or fine material properties.
No independent per-camera capture timestamps are present, so file alignment does not prove simultaneous physical exposure.
Image-space hose augmentation is for robustness; it is not a flexible-body physics model.
Generated occluder masks must either update visibility labels or be stored as unlabeled robustness views.
